needsFromHuman: A SiteMinder Exchange partnership agreement and the test environment SiteMinder issues during onboarding. Nothing here can be signed up for online.
The Bearer token from the SMX Partner Portal of that environment, stored with: creds set siteminder ...
A test hotel whose publisher provides availability and rates (the Little Hotelier certification hotel has reservations only)

For reservations from SiteMinder itself: the endpoint URL of the instance, an endpoint username and password and the hotel code handed to SiteMinder's Partner Integrations team, and somebody who creates, changes and cancels a reservation in the test hotel while a flow runs
notes: One connection holds both credential sets of a partner application (API token; endpoint username and password). Either half may be empty. Hotels are not part of the connection: the hotel code is a component input.

Reservations arrive on one plugin route. A message reaches a trigger only when its WS-Security credentials equal the endpoint credentials of the trigger's account and its HotelCode is listed in the trigger.

Not built: the write endpoints of the API (create or update rates, update availability, message status). They are in the OpenAPI file only, answer 202 with a message id, and SiteMinder's guides describe the API as read-only for applications.
Not built: any reservation read or write component. SMX has none.
Dependency: fast-xml-parser 5.12.0, the version utils/xml already ships.
verify.json has no round-trip spec: there is nothing to write.
